newsitem.title: USA: Forest Oil to redeem preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Forest Oil to redeem preferred shares.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said it intends to redeem all 2,877,673 shares of its $0.75 convertible preferred stock on February 28, 1997 -- a move that will eliminate $2.2 million in annual dividend payments.
The redemption price will be $10.00 per share plus accumulated and unpaid dividends, Forest Oil said.
In lieu of cash redemption, each preferred share may be converted into 0.7 of a share of common stock, with a market value of $11.81, Forest Oil said.
Approximately 2.0 million shares would be issued if the preferred shares were converted, the company said.

Lehman Brothers Inc has entered into a standby purchase agreement to buy the number of shares of Forest's common stock to fund the cash requirements, if any, at the time of redemption, Forest Oil said.
